title: MOTION (HUTT - LEE) relative to funding for library services provided to the public on Sundays in Council District 10.
text:
[Council File 26-1552; CD 10]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HUTT - LEE) relative to funding for library services provided to the public on Sundays in Council District 10.
Recommendation(s) for Council action: SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $175,000 from the AB1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281210 (CD 10 Redevelopment Projects - Services) to the Library Fund No. 300/44, as follows: $110,000 to Account No. 009510 (Various Special) AND $65,000 to Account No. 1010 (Salaries - General) for library services provided to the public on Sundays in Council District 10.
2. AUTHORIZE the Library Department to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
